title: Ruth Bible Quiz - Chapter 3
description: Ten questions on Ruth 3: Naomi's plan, Ruth at the threshing floor, and Boaz's promise.

questions.text: What did Naomi say Boaz would be doing that night?
questions.explanation: Naomi said Boaz would be winnowing barley that night on the threshing floor.

answers.text: Sitting with the elders at the gate
Guarding his vineyards
Winnowing barley on the threshing floor
Holding a feast for his reapers

questions.text: Until when did Naomi tell Ruth not to make herself known to Boaz?
questions.explanation: Naomi said not to make herself known to the man until he had finished eating and drinking.

answers.text: Until he had finished eating and drinking
Until the sun came up
Until the reapers had gone home
Until he called her by name

questions.text: What was Ruth to do when Boaz lay down?
questions.explanation: Naomi told her to note the place where he lay, go in, uncover his feet, and lie down.

answers.text: Wake him and speak to him
Bring him a jar of water
Sit by the door until morning
Uncover his feet and lie down

questions.text: How did Ruth answer Naomi's instructions?
questions.explanation: Ruth said to her, "All that you say, I will do."

answers.text: "I am afraid to go there."
"All that you say, I will do."
"Let me wait until tomorrow."
"Send Orpah instead of me."

questions.text: At what time was Boaz startled to find a woman at his feet?
questions.explanation: At midnight the man was startled and turned himself, and a woman lay at his feet.

answers.text: At midnight
At dawn
At evening
At noon

questions.text: What did Ruth ask Boaz to do, since he was a near kinsman?
questions.explanation: Ruth said, "Spread the corner of your garment over your servant; for you are a near kinsman."

answers.text: Give her more barley for Naomi
Take her back to the city
Spread the corner of his garment over her
Speak to the elders for her

questions.text: What did Boaz say all the city knew about Ruth?
questions.explanation: Boaz said, "All the city of my people knows that you are a worthy woman."

answers.text: That she was a rich woman
That she was a worthy woman
That she was a prophetess
That she was a daughter of his own family

questions.text: What did Boaz say about the duty of a kinsman?
questions.explanation: Boaz said that he was a near kinsman, but that there was a kinsman nearer than he.

answers.text: He had no right to redeem at all
Naomi first had to agree to it
The elders had already chosen him
There was a kinsman nearer than he

questions.text: How many measures of barley did Boaz put on Ruth's mantle?
questions.explanation: He measured six measures of barley and laid it on her, then went into the city.

answers.text: Three
Ten
Six
Two

questions.text: What did Naomi say about Boaz after Ruth told her what had happened?
questions.explanation: Naomi said, "The man will not rest until he has settled this today."

answers.text: He would not rest until he settled it that day
He would wait until the harvest was over
He would soon forget the whole matter
He would ask Ruth to return to Moab
